Tesla is seeking an early-career Software Engineer to support IT and SI infrastructure operations. The role focuses on monitoring systems, supporting incident response, reducing operational toil through automation, and improving reliability and operational processes.

Responsibilities
Assist with day-to-day monitoring, alerting, and first-line troubleshooting of IT and SI infrastructure components
Support incident response activities, including ticket handling, structured escalation, documentation of findings, and participation in post-incident reviews
Help maintain and improve operational runbooks, procedures, and knowledge base articles
Contribute to automation efforts by writing or enhancing scripts (Python, Bash) and supporting infrastructure-as-code or configuration management tasks to reduce manual toil
Collect and analyze operational metrics (availability, performance, capacity, incident trends) and help identify opportunities for process or tooling improvements
Participate in operational excellence initiatives such as standardizing processes, improving observability, supporting change management, and driving small continuous-improvement projects
Assist with capacity reviews, deployment support, health checks, and validation activities for SI training/inference clusters and core IT systems
Collaborate with infrastructure engineering, site reliability, and platform teams to improve service reliability and operational readiness
Qualification
Linux Systems Administration
Python
Bash
Monitoring and Observability
Required
Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)
Foundational knowledge of Linux systems administration and basic networking concepts
Exposure to at least one scripting language (Python or Bash preferred)
Basic understanding of monitoring and observability concepts (metrics, logs, dashboards)
Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and clear written and verbal communication
Willingness to learn complex systems, follow established procedures, and work in a collaborative team environment
Preferred
Python or Bash preferred
